sourceHeadings: Monorepo CI and independent component releases
file02MonorepoCi.role: Live bytes. OpenSIP may remain a monorepo while components release independently. Declared component ownership and dependency metadata select isolated language/component CI lanes; an unrelated change does not force every language closure to build. The selector must fail safe when ownership or dependency impact is ambiguous. Each selected component lane builds, tests, packages, signs, attests, emits an SBOM/license inventory, and qualifies its self-contained closure on the relevant manifest-declared platforms. It also runs its language-native capability/parity, behavior, performance, runtime-UX, packaging-adapter, and conformance gates. Separate lanes cover the six file-02 bullets quoted at file02SharedLaneLimbs. Independent releases do not require separate repositories and do not create lockstep versions. A release selects independently qualified compatible bytes through signed metadata and per-surface matrices. DR-121 and DR-G16 require acceptance tests for correct lane selection, omitted dependency/owner detection, per-lane exact release evidence, and cross-component integration. CI provider, YAML, repository path filters, caches, commands, and implementation tooling remain reserved for the later blueprint. This specification does not rewrite those bytes.

namedCorpusClasses.exactByteIntent: Once authored: digest-pinned hostile mutations of declared ownership and dependency metadata, including omitted dependency, omitted owner, missing component declaration, owner outside the comparison-basis universe, and incomplete or invalid universe construction (file 02 omitted dependency/owner detection). Each record retains the presented mutation, the selector's fail-safe outcome (over-selection of every lane that the mutation could affect, or a typed refusal), and proof that the mutation did not silently omit an affected lane. Fail-safe is over-selection or typed refusal, never under-selection (file 02; live waiver cell). This class is CI ownership/dependency integrity. It is not G07 hostile archive/path/loader/TOCTOU, not G10 provider-frame goldens, and not G15 adapter hostile-path emission. Fixtures are unauthored.
namedCorpusClasses.passProperty: A forced ownership or dependency mutation either selects every affected lane or refuses. Silent omit of an affected lane fails. There is no waiver for an affected omitted lane. G07, G10, and G15 are not scored here.

namedCorpusClasses.exactByteIntent: Once authored: digest-pinned records that a release selects independently qualified compatible bytes through signed metadata and per-surface matrices (file 02). Component release identity and core release identity are independently versioned. Independent releases do not require separate repositories and do not create lockstep versions. A same-version train that cannot emit a component-new/core-unchanged selection and a core-new/component-unchanged selection fails. A bundle may qualify a selection; it cannot be the only release route. DR-117 EE-7e rides this class: the selected TypeScript closure is independently releasable and not lockstepped to the core version train. Window evaluation rides DR-111 and is not minted here. Hostile dual-channel anti-lockstep goldens ride DR-127 / G21 and are not this class. v16 independently spells discriminating cases as IR-1..IR-4 and lockstep discrimination as G16-12; those identifiers are cited-not-applied and are not authored here. Fixtures are unauthored.

DR-111 windows and DR-127 dual-channel goldens are not scored here.
